author: TKCode.Arc contributors
name: TKCode.Arc Cross-platform App
description: A TKCode.Arc application for the desktop and the browser (WebAssembly): one shared project with the views and two hosts, with the same layouts and options as tkcode-arc.

choices.description: A top bar with the app name and a theme switch over one page.
A collapsible sidebar with icons (TKCode.Arc.Blocks), a top bar and page switching.
A top bar whose page switch (SegmentedControl) changes the page below it.
An IDE-style dock layout (TKCode.Arc.Dock): tool panes, document tabs, drag to dock or float, the layout saved.

mvvm.description: How the views get their data and actions.

choices.description: Code-behind: each view handles its own events.
View models with source-generated properties and commands, bound with compiled bindings.

di.description: Creates the view models and services with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection (Services/AppServices.cs). Implies --mvvm toolkit.

settings.description: Saves the appearance, the accent, the window's size and position and the layout's state (folded sidebar, dock panes, language) between runs.

i18n.description: Keeps the UI text in Localization/*.xlf (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文) and adds a language switch.

uiLanguage.description: The language of the UI text; with --i18n, the language the app starts in.

tests.description: Adds a headless test project (xunit.v3, Avalonia.Headless.XUnit), <name>.Tests/.

customTitlebar.description: Draws Arc's title bar (ArcWindow) instead of the system's, with room for your own controls in it.

accent.description: The accent color the app starts with (ArcAccentPreset).

skipRestore.description: Skips the automatic restore of the project on create.

DisplayName.description: The project name as typed, for the window title and the app name in the UI.

AssemblyIdentifier.description: The project name without the characters an identifier cannot hold: the namespace of the Arc assets generated for the app.
